hits.snippet: DETROIT \(AP\) - The U\.S\. Coast Guard has rescued three adults and a child who became stranded on a small island in the Detroit River during a kayaking trip\. The man, his wife, a 5-year-old girl, and a family friend became stranded on the island in the river’s mouth Friday after launching their kayaks from Lake Erie Metropark\. Rescue crews were sent on a boat and a helicopter, but the water around the island proved too shallow for the boat\. The kayakers were hoisted into the helicopter after 7 p\.m\. and taken to Gross Ile Municipal Airport, and treated for mild hypothermia\. The Coast Guard says the kayakers spent about four hours stranded, but were prepared with a survival kit and cell phones and had also lit a bonfire to stay warm\. # How Kozhikode’s Malabar River Festival became Asia’s biggest kayaking event - CNBC TV18 ## Kozhikode's Malabar River Festival: How a rural Kerala river became Asia's biggest kayaking event ## From a Google Maps search to an internationally recognised sporting event, here's how the Malabar River Festival helped turn Kozhikode into India's white-water kayaking hub while boosting adventure tourism and the local economy\. A rural stretch of Kozhikode in Kerala has transformed into one of Asia's leading white-water kayaking destinations, thanks to monsoon-fed rapids, strong local support and sustained government backing\. When Manik Taneja, founder of the Malabar River Festival, first typed \"river rapids\" into Google Maps, he wasn't looking for a holiday spot—he was searching for a place where India could develop white-water kayaking\. What he found on the screen was a rural stretch of Kozhikode\. What he found on the ground was what is now Asia's biggest kayaking festival\. Kozhikode is once again hosting the Malabar River Festival, now in its 12th edition, bringing together kayakers from across India and abroad for a three-day white-water competition\. # American Evy Leibfarth takes kayak slalom silver at worlds at 2028 Olympic venue Published July 23, 2026 03:48 PM Evy Leibfarth became the first American woman to win a world championships medal in kayak slalom in 23 years, taking silver at the 2028 Olympic venue in Oklahoma City on Thursday\. Leibfarth, the 2024 Olympic bronze medalist in canoe slalom, was runner-up to three-time Olympic gold medalist Jessica Fox of Australia\. Leibfarth became the first American woman to win a world medal in kayak slalom since Rebecca Giddens, a bronze medalist in 2003 and world champion in 2002\. Michal Smolen took bronze in the men’s event in 2015\. Leibfarth previously won a World Championships bronze medal in 2021 in kayak cross, a discipline that made its Olympic debut in 2024\. The World Canoe Slalom Championships continue through Saturday, streaming live on Peacock\.

According to Ottawa fire, crews got a call around 2:30 p\.m\., with **a person saying a kayaker had fallen into the Ottawa River near Petrie Island Beach** in the east end\. The caller told the communications department that the kayaker was not wearing a life jacket and was holding onto a second kayak\. When firefighters arrived they quickly launched a rescue boat and arrived to the person in the water around 2:47 p\.m\. Both kayakers were brought back to the beach just before 3:00 p\.m\. Neither had injuries\. # Newlyweds start kayak and canoe rentals at Dover's Nebi Park\. See rates, details\. DOVER — Newly married couple Maya and Paul Halthore-Kelley are opening Cochecho River Recreation, offering kayak and canoe rentals and a snack bar at the city's new Nebi Park, with a grand opening Saturday, July 25\. Kayak and canoe rentals will start right away with the snack bar planned to open in the coming weeks when permitting is in place, according to Maya\. Public boat storage will also be offered for New Hampshire and Dover residents to keep their boats near the park's paddle sports dock\. Discounted memberships for Dover residents, students and seniors will be offered\. Maya said the couple found out in April the city had accepted their proposal to operate the business at the new park, and they got married in May\. \"It all happened really fast\. It was a really lovely way to kick off our marriage,\" she said\. \"It was like, 'Not only do we get to start our marriage, but we get to start this business together and what a fun adventure it'll be together\.'\" ## What are kayak and canoe rental prices at Nebi Park?
